# Decoy

> Decoy turns production data into safe, realistic, join-preserving data for development, testing, CI, and analytics. Mask sensitive fields, generate synthetic rows, and subset related tables through explicit YAML pipelines. One engine, two ways to run it: a free, source-available CLI you run anywhere, and a self-hosted Platform your team shares. Nothing is sent to Decoy.

## Site
- [Home](https://trydecoy.com/): what Decoy is and where it fits in a pipeline.
- [CLI](https://trydecoy.com/cli/): 23 masking strategies, 12 generation types, 34 providers, FK-aware subsetting, PII scan, CI exit codes, measured performance, install.
- [Platform](https://trydecoy.com/platform/): Job Studio builder, API and webhook triggers, hash-chained audit log, four roles with OIDC SSO, connectors, Docker Compose self-hosting.
- [How it works](https://trydecoy.com/how-it-works/): scan, subset, mask or generate, validate, evidence; what happens inside a run; performance with conditions.
- [Pricing](https://trydecoy.com/pricing/): CLI free; Platform $499 per month per self-hosted instance, billed annually; Enterprise custom.
- [Security](https://trydecoy.com/security/): data boundary, outbound connections, keys and encryption, audit, compliance mapping, responsible disclosure.

## Get started
- [Install](https://trydecoy.com/docs/start/install): Install the decoy CLI, check your environment with decoy doctor, and understand the license.
- [Quickstart](https://trydecoy.com/docs/start/quickstart): From a CSV to a masked CSV with the decoy CLI, using a scaffolded pipeline, config validation, and a run.
- [Demo](https://trydecoy.com/docs/start/demo): Run the bundled decoy demo to see a scan-then-mask walkthrough on sample data, no config or input file required.

## Guides
- [Scan for PII](https://trydecoy.com/docs/how-to/scan-for-pii): Profile a dataset with decoy scan, review what it found, and turn the findings into an explicit masking pipeline.
- [Choose a masking strategy](https://trydecoy.com/docs/how-to/choose-a-masking-strategy): Pick the right strategy for each column.
- [Mask a CSV](https://trydecoy.com/docs/how-to/mask-a-csv): Mask one CSV file with a mix of value-keyed and one-way strategies, and prove the keyed strategy is deterministic.
- [Use Parquet files](https://trydecoy.com/docs/how-to/use-parquet): Read and write Parquet instead of CSV.
- [Mask a folder with foreign keys](https://trydecoy.com/docs/how-to/mask-a-folder-with-foreign-keys): Mask two related tables in one run so the join between them survives.
- [Subset a dataset](https://trydecoy.com/docs/how-to/subset-a-dataset): Pull a small, referentially intact slice of related tables.
- [Generate synthetic data](https://trydecoy.com/docs/how-to/generate-synthetic-data): Build a synthetic table from a column spec, then fit a real table's shape and sample from it instead.
- [Use differential privacy](https://trydecoy.com/docs/how-to/use-differential-privacy): Step-by-step recipe for generating differentially private synthetic data with epsilon/delta budgets.
- [Redact text with NER detection](https://trydecoy.com/docs/how-to/redact-text-with-ner): Activate named-entity recognition to detect and redact person names and locations in free text.
- [Work with healthcare code sets](https://trydecoy.com/docs/how-to/work-with-healthcare-code-sets): Use ICD-10, HCPCS, NDC, and custom code set columns for masking and generation.
- [Handle high-cardinality categorical data](https://trydecoy.com/docs/how-to/handle-high-cardinality-categories): Generate and preserve columns with thousands of distinct categories like diagnosis codes or SKUs.
- [Use Decoy in CI](https://trydecoy.com/docs/how-to/use-decoy-in-ci): Run decoy non-interactively, gate a build on its exit code, and keep the evidence artifact.
- [Unmask data](https://trydecoy.com/docs/how-to/unmask-data): Recover original values from a masked file.

## Concepts
- [Determinism](https://trydecoy.com/docs/concepts/determinism): The seed protocol behind reproducible masking and generation.
- [Keys and the vault](https://trydecoy.com/docs/concepts/keys-and-vault): How Decoy sources the secret behind masking, and how the token vault makes a one-way mask reversible.
- [Scan](https://trydecoy.com/docs/concepts/scan): What the scan does, and why it suggests rather than decides.
- [Disguises](https://trydecoy.com/docs/concepts/disguises): What a Disguise is, and what it is not.
- [Differential privacy in Decoy](https://trydecoy.com/docs/concepts/differential-privacy): Marginal differential privacy on generated synthetic data using typed carriers and configurable epsilon/delta budgets.

## Strategies
- [Masking strategies](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies): The 23 mask strategies, grouped by what they do.
- [faker](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/faker): Replace with a realistic value from a named provider.
- [hash](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/hash): Replace a value with a keyed, deterministic digest.
- [redact](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/redact): Replace every value with a fixed placeholder.
- [fpe](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/fpe): Encrypt in place while preserving the format.
- [passthrough](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/passthrough): Leave the value unchanged.
- [categorical](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/categorical): Remap values onto a fixed set of categories.
- [shuffle](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/shuffle): Shuffle a column to break row identity.
- [truncate](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/truncate): Keep the first or last N characters.
- [bucketize](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/bucketize): Round numbers into fixed-width bins.
- [top_code](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/top-code): Collapse the rare tail of a numeric column into a label.
- [date_shift](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/date-shift): Shift dates by a deterministic, bounded offset.
- [bucket_perturb](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/bucket-perturb): Snap a date to a deterministic position in its week, month, or quarter.
- [windowed_date](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/windowed-date): Move a date to a random point in a window.
- [geo_generalize](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/geo-generalize): Generalize a location through a cascade of coarser levels.
- [text_redact](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/text-redact): Find PII in free text and redact it.
- [text_mask](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/text-mask): Find PII in free text and replace it.
- [code_set](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/code-set): Replace a code with another valid code from the same set.
- [derived](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/derived): Compute a value from an expression over the row.
- [formula](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/formula): Compute a value from an expression over the cell.
- [derived_aggregate](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/derived-aggregate): Replace a value with an aggregate across rows.
- [group_key](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/group-key): Give every row in a group the same deterministic key.
- [grouped_series](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/grouped-series): Generate a per-group sequence.
- [joint_mask](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/strategies/joint-mask): Mask correlated columns together from a reference table.
- [Synthetic data providers](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/providers): The named value sources for the faker strategy and generation type.
- [Foreign keys and relationships](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/relationships): Keep foreign keys joinable after masking, across every FK shape.

## Connectors
- [Connectors and formats](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/connectors): The file, S3, and GCS backends a Decoy pipeline can name as a source or target.
- [S3](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/connectors/s3): Pipeline YAML shape and credentials for an S3 (or S3-compatible) source or target.
- [GCS](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/connectors/gcs): Pipeline YAML shape and credentials for a Google Cloud Storage source or target.
- [SFTP](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/connectors/sftp): Current status of the SFTP connector, what exists, and what a pipeline cannot do with it yet.

## CLI reference
- [CLI reference](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli): Generated, per-command reference for the decoy CLI, kept in sync with the CLI itself.
- [decoy run](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/run): Run a decoy pipeline from a YAML config.
- [decoy unmask](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/unmask): Recover fpe-masked columns from a masked file using the pipeline config.
- [decoy fit](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/fit): Fit a distribution-snapshot artifact for statistical generation.
- [decoy init](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/init): Scaffold a starter pipeline YAML through a short Q&A.
- [decoy demo](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/demo): Walk through scan then mask on a bundled sample dataset.
- [decoy explain](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/explain): Explain a Decoy concept in plain English.
- [decoy info](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/info): Print the Decoy CLI banner with quick-start hints.
- [decoy schema](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/schema): Print the PipelineConfig JSON Schema to stdout.
- [decoy list](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/list): List the contents of one engine registry: strategies, providers, checksums, validators, templates, or disguises.
- [decoy show](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/show): Show detail for one reference item: a strategy, provider, template, or the config schema.
- [decoy doctor](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/doctor): Check engine and dependency health.
- [decoy subset](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/subset): Cut a referentially-complete FK-aware subset of a relational dataset.
- [decoy validate](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/validate): Pre-run validation gate: config, compile, and preflight checks.
- [decoy scan](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/scan): Profile a dataset for PII and re-identification risk.
- [decoy report](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/cli/report): The post-run evidence surface: show, render, verify, fidelity, integrity, diff, and vault.
- [Exit codes](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/exit-codes): Why the exit-code contract is a design commitment, not an afterthought.
- [Security, privacy, and compliance limits](https://trydecoy.com/docs/reference/limits): The honest boundary around what Decoy guarantees, so you don't rely on a promise it doesn't make.
